headline: A 2016 law renamed the post office at 99 West 2nd Street in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, after Lieutenant Colonel James "Maggie" Megellas.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, a new official name. The building is now called the Lieutenant Colonel James "Maggie" Megellas Post Office. It honors Megellas, a decorated Army officer. The law does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 18, 2016.
